description: Project scaffolding, dependency installation, documentation suite, Prisma schema + migrations, NextAuth.js v5 auth, and database seed. This is the foundation all other FEATs depend on.
steps: Run `npx create-next-app@latest . --typescript --tailwind --eslint --app --src-dir --import-alias '@/*'` inside /Users/macbookpro/www/wss-qr-signature. When prompted: use App Router = yes. This scaffolds package.json, tsconfig.json (strict true already set by CNA), tailwind.config.ts, next.config.ts, src/app/layout.tsx, src/app/page.tsx, src/app/globals.css.

Install all runtime deps with exact versions: `npm install --save-exact prisma @prisma/client next-auth@beta @auth/prisma-adapter qrcode @napi-rs/canvas nanoid zod lucide-react sharp`. Install dev deps: `npm install --save-exact -D @types/qrcode vitest @vitest/coverage-v8 @testing-library/react @testing-library/user-event @testing-library/jest-dom jsdom`.

Create vitest.config.ts at repo root with jsdom environment, globals:true, and setupFiles pointing to src/test/setup.ts. Create src/test/setup.ts that imports '@testing-library/jest-dom'. Add npm scripts to package.json: 'typecheck': 'tsc --noEmit', 'test': 'vitest run', 'test:coverage': 'vitest run --coverage'.
Create .env.example with all 5 required vars documented (NEXTAUTH_SECRET, DATABASE_URL, NEXTAUTH_URL, BASE_URL, UPLOAD_DIR). Add .env to .gitignore.

Write all 8 documentation files in docs/: PRD.md (grounded in roadmaps-wss-qr-signature.md), ARCHITECTURE.md (Next.js App Router structure, service layer separation, file storage), DATABASE_SCHEMA.md (ER diagram in text + all entities), API_SPEC.md (all 10 endpoints with request/response shapes and error codes), DESIGN_SYSTEM.md (fill DESIGN_SYSTEM.md template with actual tokens: navy #1e3a5f primary, Inter font, compact spacing), SECURITY.md (auth, RBAC, rate limiting, upload validation, audit policy), IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md (summary of this plan), DESIGN_DECISIONS.md (fill DESIGN_DECISIONS.md template: Enterprise Information System direction, alternatives considered: SaaS-dashboard rejected for being generic, Material Design rejected for consumer feel).
Initialize Prisma: `npx prisma init --datasource-provider sqlite`. This creates prisma/schema.prisma and adds DATABASE_URL to .env. Create .env from .env.example and set DATABASE_URL=file:./dev.db.

Write complete Prisma schema in prisma/schema.prisma with these exact models: User (id String @id @default(cuid), email String @unique, name String, passwordHash String, role UserRole @default(ADMIN), createdAt DateTime @default(now()), updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt), Organization (id String @id @default(cuid), name String, slug String @unique, logoPath String?, address String?, website String?, createdAt/updatedAt), OrganizationalUnit (id String @id @default(cuid), orgId String, org Organization @relation, name String, code String?, createdAt DateTime @default(now())), Signer (id/orgId/org/fullName/title/employeeId String?/isActive Boolean @default(true)/createdAt/updatedAt), DocumentIssuance (id/ref String @unique/orgId/org/unitId?/unit?/signerId/signer/title/docNumber/docType/description String?/docDate DateTime/issuanceTimestamp DateTime/expiresAt DateTime?/status DocumentStatus @default(DRAFT)/adminNotes String?/createdById/createdBy/assets GeneratedAsset[]/statusHistory IssuanceStatusHistory[]/auditEvents AuditEvent[]/createdAt/updatedAt), GeneratedAsset (id/issuanceId/issuance/type AssetType/filePath/fileSize Int/mimeType/createdAt), IssuanceStatusHistory (id/issuanceId/issuance/fromStatus/toStatus/reason String?/actorId String?/actor User?/createdAt), AuditEvent (id/actorId String?/actor User?/action String/entityType String/entityId String/meta Json?/ipAddress String?/createdAt DateTime @default(now())). Enums: UserRole(ADMIN), DocumentStatus(DRAFT|ISSUED|REVOKED|EXPIRED), AssetType(QR_PNG|SIGNATURE_BLOCK).
Run `npx prisma migrate dev --name init` to create migration and generate client. Run `npx prisma generate`.

Write prisma/seed.ts: bcrypt-hash a password for admin@example.com (use bcryptjs), create 1 Organization, 1 OrganizationalUnit, 2 Signers, 1 DRAFT issuance, 1 ISSUED issuance (with ref via nanoid(21)), 1 REVOKED issuance. Add to package.json: `'prisma': { 'seed': 'npx ts-node prisma/seed.ts' }`. Run `npx prisma db seed`.
Create src/lib/db.ts: Prisma client singleton using global.__prisma guard to prevent hot-reload connection exhaustion in Next.js dev.

Create src/auth.ts: NextAuth v5 config with credentials provider (find user by email, compare bcrypt hash, return {id, email, name, role}), PrismaAdapter, JWT session strategy. Augment session type to include role. Create src/types/next-auth.d.ts to extend Session and JWT types with role:UserRole. Create src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts exporting handlers.
Create src/middleware.ts: protect all routes matching /admin/* by checking for valid NextAuth session. Unauthenticated requests redirect to /sign-in?callbackUrl=<original>.
Create src/lib/auth-utils.ts: requireAdmin(request) throws Response with 401 if no session, 403 if role !== ADMIN. getSession() thin wrapper around NextAuth auth().
acceptance_criteria: npm run build exits 0 with no TypeScript errors
npx prisma migrate dev exits 0 (migration applied)
npx prisma db seed exits 0 (seed data present)
Navigating to /admin without a session redirects to /sign-in (middleware working)
findings: Prisma 7.x breaking changes vs FEAT-001 spec (written for Prisma 5.x): (1) PrismaClient now requires a driver adapter — installed @prisma/adapter-better-sqlite3 for SQLite dev. (2) Generated client outputs to src/generated/prisma/ (excluded from git; npx prisma generate required after clone). (3) Seed config moved from package.json to prisma7.config.ts migrations.seed. (4) Next.js 16.x renamed middleware.ts to proxy.ts — file exported as async function proxy(). (5) nanoid v6 API unchanged. (6) nextauth v5 beta: no PrismaAdapter needed for JWT strategy — credentials provider + JWT callbacks handle user lookup directly. All verification commands pass: npm run build, npm run typecheck, npx prisma validate, npx prisma db seed all exit 0.
